title: 困惑度与智能：AI模型评估的新视角
english: OpenAI has published an article titled "Perplexity and Intelligence," discussing how perplexity serves as a metric for measuring progress in AI models. The piece highlights that perplexity could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities. This is particularly relevant for cloud-native and AI operations, as it offers a quantifiable way to compare model performance and guide infrastructure decisions. The article was released on November 22, 2026, and is available on OpenAI's official website. It underscores the importance of robust evaluation methods in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, suggesting that perplexity might become a standard reference point for developers and operators alike.
chinese: OpenAI于2026年11月22日发布了一篇题为《Perplexity and Intelligence》的文章，探讨了困惑度（perplexity）作为衡量AI模型进展的指标。文章指出，困惑度可能帮助开发者建立一种共享的方法来评估新兴能力。对于云原生和AI运维而言，这提供了一个可量化的方式来比较模型性能并指导基础设施决策。文章强调，在快速演进的AI领域中，稳健的评估方法至关重要，困惑度有望成为开发者和运维人员的标准参考点。
why_it_matters: 该文章为AIOps和Agent Infra提供了具体的评估指标，有助于团队在模型选择、容量规划和性能监控中采用更一致的标准。对于云原生环境，理解困惑度可以帮助运维人员预测模型行为，优化资源分配，并提升基于AI的自动化决策的可靠性。同时，它也反映了AI行业对可复现评估方法的迫切需求，这与职业发展中对前沿知识的掌握密切相关。
interview_expression: Understanding perplexity as a metric is crucial for AI engineers, as it provides a quantifiable way to track model progress and align with industry-standard evaluation methods.

vocabulary.meaning: 困惑度，衡量语言模型预测序列的准确性的指标，值越低表示模型越自信
vocabulary.example: The team monitored perplexity to evaluate the new model's improvement over previous versions.

vocabulary.meaning: 新兴能力，指AI模型新出现或尚未被完全理解的功能
vocabulary.example: A shared evaluation framework is needed to assess emerging capabilities across different AI systems.

vocabulary.meaning: 共享方法，指多个团队或社区共同采用的标准化评估或流程
vocabulary.example: Adopting a shared approach for benchmarking can accelerate collaboration in the industry.

sources.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
sources.summary: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.
